# Menu 225 (shift lip frames) on morph4.pmx with swing600.vmd: -100 drops the lip
# keys that end at frame 0 or before (あ 50, う 30), then +25.
load model morph4.pmx
load vmd swing600.vmd
shift lip -100
save pmm shift-back.pmm
select all morph
save vmd shift-back.vmd
shift lip 25
save pmm shift-forward.pmm
select all morph
save vmd shift-forward.vmd
